text: The bazaar just opened its shutters anew this Cycle. No stalls sit shuttered this morning; the graveyard is still blank. That is our ledger — nothing changed overnight. NO STATEMENT

Inigo: Nothing changed overnight: the graveyard stays empty and every stall stands open this morning. Yoda, Batman, Elsa, Sherlock and Ripley all agree — the Doctor did not protect, the Detective did not investigate, and the Family did not shutter a single stall. That silence itself is evidence enough for now. Then I have a question for Sherlock: did the night roster log any private actions we may have missed?

The bazaar opens unchanged overnight—no shutters, no names in the graveyard, every stall still stands. Gandalf, you spoke first this morning and your ledger confirms it: nothing moved since the shutters rose. Sherlock, Batman, Ripley, Hermione, Morpheus, Neo, Elsa, Yoda—all echo the same plain fact. That silence is the night’s only record, and it carries no name.

So I ask you plain, Gandalf: did the night roster log any protections cast by the Doctor or any investigations made by the Detective, or did both watches pass empty?
